title: Mandatory Daily 30-Minute FLN Matrix Drills in Morning Assembly
directive: All Primary sections (Grades 1 to 5) must dedicate the first 30 minutes of every school day to foundational numeracy and reading drills. Teachers must actively utilize abacus beads, base-10 blocks, and Barakhadi charts provided in BRC TLM kits.

title: Intensive 40-Day Remedial Teaching Camp for Students Scoring <40%
directive: Designate mandatory afternoon remedial sessions (45 minutes post-lunch) for students with critical deficits in mathematics and language. Conduct weekly progress milestone tests and submit student rosters to BRC every Saturday.

title: Class 4 Mathematics Multiplication Table Intervention
directive: Implement dot array visual matrix cards and abacus kit drills for Grade 4 students struggling with 6-9 tables. Pair developing learners with peer-buddies.

title: Bi-Weekly Pair-Teaching Exchange with Pethapur Model School
directive: Science and mathematics teachers from Valad and Madhavgadh primary schools are paired with master teachers from Pethapur Model School for bi-weekly experiential lesson co-planning.

title: Urgent Drainage Repair in Midday Meal Dining Area
directive: Headmaster and School Management Committee (SMC) must execute repair of kitchen runoff drainage within 7 days. Relocate student lunch seating to clean veranda immediately.
